matches.rationale: No finding addresses the altered constrained-problem/dual formulation in §4.1: the inequality constraints, the Lagrange multipliers on |γ_i| ≤ δ_i, or the claimed inconsistency with the primal/dual updates. The §4.1 findings target Theorem 4.1/Assumption 1, not that formulation defect.

Findings 2 and 4 show that Theorem 4.1 and its proof rely on an unstated operator-bound hypothesis under the stated Assumption 1, while finding 3 shows Theorem 4.2's stated bound is not implied by its refined version. All three point at the same weakened/contradictory assumption-theorem guarantees described in GT2.
